verdict.rationale: iTerm2's AppleScript docs say stand-alone scripts can launch the app and open multiple sessions with profiles in new tabs or windows, which is the core of a one-command workspace. The Python API offers broader programmatic control, and a community user praises it as touching "pretty much everything." tmux -CC attach can also reopen windows in their prior state. Missing for 10: a declarative config-file or saved-layout mechanism, explicit evidence of scripting pane splits and layouts, and hands-on corroboration of a full project workspace opening from one command.
